concept: Nightclub doorman: huge, shaved head, earpiece, black bomber jacket open over a red shirt, black trousers, boots. Slow, blocks a lot, hits hard with a two-handed smash and grabs. Guards the doors on Mill Street.

generator.mode: PixelLab v3, 76px canvas (the 96px canvas made him 91px tall, boss size), side view, facing right, native size: target_height is the base's real height (74), scale 1.0. Base generated in the fighting stance and used as the start frame for every animation.
generator.prompt: huge heavy-set nightclub bouncer doorman, shaved head, earpiece with coiled wire, open black bomber jacket worn unzipped showing a bright red shirt underneath, black trousers, black boots, menacing fighting stance with big fists raised, full body, detailed 32-bit pixel art, clean dark outline

animation_notes.smash: two-handed smash, raised overhead and brought down forward in front of him
animation_notes.grab: lunges forward and grabs with both hands at chest height

idle.note: raw/pixellab/idle frames 0-1-2-3-2-1 ping-pong (second take; later frames turn toward the camera in both takes), padded (32,20) onto the 116x132 knockdown canvas so frame 0 lines up with knockdown frame 0

windup.note: raw/pixellab/smash frames 1-6: raises both arms overhead and starts the swing, over the 0.4 s windup_time

smash.note: raw/pixellab/smash frames 7, 8, 8: the two-handed blow lands in front of him on frame 0. Hit 0-0.1 s and attack_duration 0.33 s keep the old smash's timing. Second take: the first turned to the camera and lost the shirt

grab.note: raw/pixellab/grab frames 1-8: lunges in, both hands forward at chest height; held through grab_hold_time

hurt.note: raw/pixellab/knockdown frames 1-2-3-2-1: the backward stagger (the v3 hurt only turned to the camera)

knockdown.note: raw/pixellab/knockdown frames 1-9; frame 4's white swoosh marks were removed by hand

getup.note: raw/pixellab/getup frames 1-10, generated from knockdown frame 10 to knockdown frame 0 (the stance) on the same 116x132 canvas
